    SELECT TOP(1) [s].[MaSach], [s].[AnhBia], [s].[Barcode], [s].[ISBN], [s].[MaKe], [s].[MaNXB], [s].[MaTheLoai], [s].[MoTa], [s].[NamXuatBan], [s].[NgayCapNhat], [s].[NgayTao], [s].[NgonNgu], [s].[SoLuongKhaDung], [s].[SoLuongKho], [s].[SoTrang], [s].[TenSach], [s].[TrangThai]
    FROM [Sach] AS [s]
    WHERE [s].[MaSach] = @__maSach_0
) AS [s0]
LEFT JOIN [CuonSach] AS [c] ON [s0].[MaSach] = [c].[MaSach]
ORDER BY [s0].[MaSach]
